attributes.additional_details:
Everyone should have the right to free employment law advice and guidance. 
Review how insurance companies deal with claims, the employee should have more control and more say. 
Employees having no rights for 2 years allows employers to churn through staff and mis treat them. 
There should be a law stopping employers accessing personal emails under any circumstances. 
Employment contracts should be issued at job offer stage 
Restrictions stopping employees working in their industry needs to stop
attributes.background:
Review the accessibility and affordability of employment law advice. Employers should not be allowed to do as they wish as they know most can’t afford legal representation.
Review employment insurance assessments.
Employers should not be allowed to access personal emails in any circumstances.

rejection.details:
I'm afraid we find your petition unclear - we do not know what your reference to employment insurance assessments is.  Employees are currently prohibited from accessing the personal emails of employees.  We are not clear whether you want free legal advice, or rather a review of the provision of legal advice.

The issue about contracts in the penultimate lines seem to be different request and could form the basis of a separate petition. The last line isn't clear to us either.
